title: Take this medicine
summary: Give and understand instructions about medicine, food and drink, including 'don't…!' with لَا تَشْرَبْ, لَا تَنْسَ.
intro: Dr Fatima phones Daniel to check that he is taking his medicine. Today you learn to tell someone not to do something: keep the 'you' form of the present, put لَا in front, and end it like an order. تَشْرَبُ (you drink) becomes لَا تَشْرَبْ (don't drink!), and تَنْسَى (you forget) becomes لَا تَنْسَ (don't forget!). You also meet three short, irregular orders: خُذْ (take!), كُلْ (eat!) and نَمْ (sleep!).
objectives: Tell a man and a woman not to do something with لَا
Use the irregular orders خُذْ, كُلْ and نَمْ
Understand the instructions on a medicine leaflet
Talk about food and drink when you are ill: honey, lemon, hot and cold

realLife.title: A call from the doctor
realLife.story: On Wednesday evening Dr Fatima calls. Daniel admits that he slept until noon and forgot his morning tablet, and that he is drinking a big cup of coffee. The doctor has some clear instructions for him.

sentences.en: Take this medicine after food. (to a man)
sentences.literal: take this medicine after the eating

segs: drink (to a man; i joins it to the next word)

mistakes.why: lā tashrabu (with -u) is a statement: 'you don't drink coffee'. An order not to do something has no -u: lā tashrab, and before al- it becomes lā tashrabi l-qahwa.

sentences.literal: don't forget your appointment, O Layla

mistakes.why: To a woman the ending is -ay: lā tansay. lā tansā is a statement to a man, 'you don't forget'.

sentences.en: Eat a little, and drink some water. (to a woman)
sentences.literal: eat a little, and drink water

sentences.en: Drink tea with honey and lemon. (to a man)
sentences.literal: drink tea with the honey and the lemon

dialogue.title: Doctor's orders
dialogue.culture: حَاضِر (literally 'present, ready') is a polite 'will do!' or 'right away!' when someone asks you to do something. Tea with honey and lemon, or a hot drink of aniseed or ginger, is the classic home remedy for a cold in Egypt.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر يَا دَانْيَال، أَنَا الدُّكْتُورَة فَاطِمَة. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ الْيَوْمَ؟
lines.en: Good evening, Daniel, this is Dr Fatima. How are you today?
segs: the doctor (a woman, as a title)

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ النُّور يَا دُكْتُورَة! أَنَا أَحْسَن، لٰكِنِّي مَا زِلْتُ أَسْعُلُ قَلِيلًا.
lines.en: Good evening, doctor! I'm better, but I am still coughing a little.
segs: I ceased ('mā ziltu': I am still)

lines.ar: هَلْ تَأْخُذُ الدَّوَاء كُلَّ يَوْم؟ حَبَّة ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات فِي الْيَوْم، أَلَيْسَ كَذٰلِكَ؟
lines.en: Are you taking the medicine every day? One tablet three times a day, isn't that right?

lines.ar: الْحَقِيقَة… الْيَوْمَ نَسِيتُ حَبَّةَ الصَّبَاح، لِأَنِّي نِمْتُ حَتَّى الظُّهْر.
lines.en: To be honest… today I forgot the morning tablet, because I slept until noon.

lines.ar: لَا تَنْسَ الدَّوَاء يَا دَانْيَال! كُلْ شَيْئًا، ثُمَّ خُذْ حَبَّةً الْآنَ.
lines.en: Don't forget the medicine, Daniel! Eat something, and then take a tablet now.

lines.ar: حَاضِر! وَأَنَا أَشْرَبُ الْآنَ قَهْوَة كَبِيرَة، لِأَنِّي أُحِبُّ الْقَهْوَة جِدًّا.
lines.en: Will do! And right now I'm drinking a big coffee, because I really love coffee.

lines.ar: لَا، لَا! لَا تَشْرَبِ الْقَهْوَة الْآنَ. اِشْرَبْ مَاءً، أَوْ شَايًا بِالْعَسَل وَاللَّيْمُون.
lines.en: No, no! Don't drink coffee now. Drink water, or tea with honey and lemon.
segs: drink (to a man; i joins it to the next word)

lines.ar: شَاي بِالْعَسَل؟ فِكْرَة جَمِيلَة. وَهَلْ أَشْرَبُهُ سَاخِنًا أَمْ بَارِدًا؟
lines.en: Tea with honey? What a nice idea. And should I drink it hot or cold?

lines.ar: اِشْرَبْهُ سَاخِنًا، وَلَا تَشْرَبْ مَاءً بَارِدًا جِدًّا، فَهُوَ سَيِّئ لِحَلْقِكَ.
lines.en: Drink it hot, and don't drink very cold water, because it is bad for your throat.

lines.ar: طَيِّب. وَالشَّرَاب؟ أَخَذْتُ مِلْعَقَتَيْنِ أَمْسِ قَبْلَ النَّوْم. هَلْ هٰذَا جَيِّد؟
lines.en: OK. And the syrup? I took two spoonfuls last night before bed. Is that good?

lines.ar: لَا، مِلْعَقَة وَاحِدَة فَقَطْ! لَا تَأْخُذْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مِلْعَقَة فِي اللَّيْل.
lines.en: No, only one spoonful! Don't take more than one spoonful at night.

lines.ar: فَهِمْتُ. وَالْأَكْل؟ لَيْسَتْ عِنْدِي شَهِيَّة، وَلَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ آكُلَ شَيْئًا.
lines.en: I understand. And food? I have no appetite, and I don't want to eat anything.

lines.ar: كُلْ قَلِيلًا عَلَى الْأَقَلّ: شُورْبَةً أَوْ خُبْزًا أَوْ مَوْزَةً. لَا تَأْخُذِ الدَّوَاء بِدُونِ أَكْل.
lines.en: Eat a little at least: some soup, bread or a banana. Don't take the medicine without food.
segs: take (to a man; i joins it to the next word)

lines.ar: حَاضِر يَا دُكْتُورَة. شُكْرًا جَزِيلًا عَلَى اتِّصَالِكِ، أَنْتِ لَطِيفَة جِدًّا.
lines.en: Will do, doctor. Thank you very much for calling; you are very kind.

lines.ar: عَفْوًا! نَمْ جَيِّدًا، وَلَا تَنْسَ: مَوْعِدُنَا يَوْمَ الْخَمِيس فِي الْعِيَادَة.
lines.en: You're welcome! Sleep well, and don't forget: our appointment is on Thursday at the clinic.

reading.title: The medicine leaflet
reading.ar: تَعْلِيمَاتُ الدَّوَاء: خُذْ حَبَّة وَاحِدَة ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات فِي الْيَوْم بَعْدَ الْأَكْل. لَا تَأْخُذْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلَاثِ حَبَّات فِي الْيَوْم. لَا تَشْرَبِ الْقَهْوَة مَعَ الدَّوَاء. اِحْفَظِ الدَّوَاء فِي مَكَان بَارِد.
reading.en: Instructions for the medicine: Take one tablet three times a day after food. Do not take more than three tablets a day. Do not drink coffee with the medicine. Keep the medicine in a cool place.
segs: drink (to a man; i joins it to the next word)

quiz.prompt: How do you say 'Don't forget!' to a man?
What does Dr Fatima tell Daniel to drink?
Choose the correct order to a woman: 'Eat a little!'
How much syrup should Daniel take at night?
Which letter is the kh sound at the start of خُذْ?

completion: Brilliant! You can give and follow instructions, including 'don't…!'. Daniel promises to take his medicine and to drink tea with honey, not coffee.
